title: 2022 AMC 12B Problem 11
statement: Let \[ \begin{aligned} f(n) &= \left(\dfrac{-1 + i\sqrt3}{2}\right)^n \\ &\quad {}+ \left(\dfrac{-1 - i\sqrt3}{2}\right)^n, \end{aligned} \] where \(i = \sqrt{-1}.\) What is \(f(2022)?\)

solutions.text:
The two bases are the primitive cube roots of unity, \(\omega = e^{\frac{2\pi i}{3}}\) and its conjugate \(\omega^2 = e^{-\frac{2\pi i}{3}}.\) So \(f(n) = \omega^n + \omega^{-n} = 2\cos\dfrac{2\pi n}{3}.\)

Since \(2022\) is a multiple of \(3,\) \(\omega^{2022} = 1,\) so \(f(2022) = 1 + 1 = 2.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: The two bases are the primitive cube roots of unity, \(\omega\) and \(\omega^2\)
